d:
Clouds of uncertainty are gathering over Chief Minister Omar Abdullah’s position in Jammu and Kashmir. Reports suggest that around 25 MLAs from his own party, the National Conference, are in a rebellious mood. These MLAs have issued a 14-day ultimatum to the party leadership, warning that if their demands are not met, they will approach the Raj Bhavan to withdraw their support for the government.
